stories.title: Monster Face Pie: A Halloween Dinner Story
stories.description: A quick visual guide to building a crisp, golden Monster Face Pie with a rich beef-and-vegetable filling.

slides.headline: A golden pie with a playful monster face
slides.body: A warm beef-and-vegetable pie becomes a Halloween centrepiece with a few simple pastry decorations.

slides.headline: Keep the filling thick, not wet
slides.body: Cook onion and carrot until soft, brown the beef, then simmer with tomato paste, thyme and stock until the mixture holds on a spoon.

slides.headline: Cool first for a crisp base
slides.body: Let the filling lose its steam before it meets the pastry. This helps the lower crust bake rather than turn soft.

slides.headline: Seal, vent and decorate
slides.body: Crimp the pastry edge firmly. Add olive, cheese and pepper pieces for the face, leaving a few small vents clear.

slides.headline: Bake until deeply golden
slides.body: Bake at 200°C until the pastry is crisp and richly coloured. Rest the pie for ten minutes so the slices hold together.

slides.headline: Dinner with a Halloween twist
slides.body: The full recipe includes exact ingredient amounts, timing and storage guidance.

stories.title: Pizza Skulls: A Halloween Snack Story
stories.description: A quick visual guide to making crisp, cheese-filled Pizza Skulls for a Halloween snack table.

slides.headline: Crisp pizza pockets in a skull shape
slides.body: Pizza dough, sauce, cheese and a mould are all you need for a shareable spooky snack.

slides.headline: Grease every small detail
slides.body: Coat the eye sockets and edges of the skull mould well so the hot pockets release cleanly after baking.

slides.headline: Press dough into each cavity
slides.body: Use dough slightly larger than the mould. Ease it into the contours without stretching it thin at the edges.

slides.headline: A little filling gives a better shape
slides.body: Add sauce, mozzarella, sausage and pepper below the rim. Overfilling is the main reason pockets split.

slides.headline: Close the skulls before the oven
slides.body: Top with dough, press the edges closed and bake at 190°C until firm and browned around the details.

slides.headline: Let the cheese cool briefly
slides.body: Turn the skulls out carefully and serve with warm pizza sauce. The full recipe has the exact portions.
slides.cta: Get the full Pizza Skulls recipe

stories.title: Mummy Pizza: A Halloween Dinner Story
stories.description: A quick visual guide to making a crisp personal Mummy Pizza with mozzarella bandages and olive eyes.

slides.headline: A fast pizza dressed as a mummy
slides.body: This easy personal pizza uses pita, tomato sauce, mozzarella strips and olive eyes for a fun dinner.

slides.headline: Heat the oven to 220°C
slides.body: Place the pitas on a baking sheet so their bases can crisp while the cheese melts.

slides.headline: Keep the sauce light
slides.body: Spread sauce over each pita, leaving a narrow border. A thin coating keeps the base from becoming soft.

slides.headline: Leave gaps between cheese strips
slides.body: Lay mozzarella in uneven bands so the red sauce remains visible. Save a small open space for olive eyes.

slides.headline: Look for crisp edges
slides.body: Bake until the pita is firm and the mozzarella has melted and lightly browned at the edges.

slides.headline: Slice after a short rest
slides.body: Let the pizza cool just enough to set the cheese. The full recipe includes exact amounts and substitutions.

slides.body: Golden pastry and melted cheese turn simple sticks into a playful Halloween platter.

slides.body: Cut pastry into similar-width strips so they bake at the same pace and are easy to arrange.

slides.headline: Keep cheese away from the edge
slides.body: Leave a narrow border before sealing; this helps the cheese stay inside instead of escaping.

slides.headline: Add the nail before baking
slides.body: Press one blanched almond into each tip gently, then score small knuckle lines with a knife.

slides.body: Savory ground-beef sandwiches enriched with pumpkin purée, tomato and warm spices for autumn.

slides.headline: Start with the key components
slides.body: Gather g ground beef, onion, diced, cup pumpkin purée and set up your workspace before you begin.

slides.headline: Build the Halloween detail with care
slides.body: Brown the beef and onion in a skillet, breaking the meat into small pieces and draining excess fat if needed.

slides.headline: Let texture lead the timing
slides.body: Simmer gently until thick enough to spoon onto buns without running off.

slides.headline: Finish, cool, and share
slides.body: Fill buns just before serving and offer pickles or slaw alongside.

stories.title: Spider Deviled Eggs: A Halloween Recipe Story
stories.description: A short, practical visual guide to creamy deviled eggs topped with olive spiders for a classic, protein-rich halloween appetizer.

slides.headline: Spider Deviled Eggs
slides.body: Creamy deviled eggs topped with olive spiders for a classic, protein-rich Halloween appetizer.

slides.headline: Start with the key components
slides.body: Gather large eggs, tablespoons mayonnaise, teaspoon Dijon mustard and set up your workspace before you begin.

slides.headline: Build the Halloween detail with care
slides.body: Hard-cook the eggs, cool in ice water and peel them carefully.

slides.headline: Let texture lead the timing
slides.body: Spoon or pipe the filling into the egg whites.

slides.headline: Finish, cool, and share
slides.body: Keep chilled until serving and refrigerate promptly after the buffet.
